CommunityApplications.Profile:
WebSSH is a self-hosted, multi-user SSH and SFTP client in the browser, maintained in the open at github.com/bifrost0x/webssh under the Apache License 2.0.
This repository publishes one app: WebSSH, from the multi-architecture image ghcr.io/bifrost0x/webssh (amd64 and arm64). The Unraid template lives next to the source, so new settings, ports or volumes ship together with the template change.
WebSSH is an SSH gateway. Keep it on your LAN or behind a VPN, and follow the production guide before exposing it through a reverse proxy.
Support thread: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/201292-support-bifrost0x-webssh/ Bug reports and feature requests: https://github.com/bifrost0x/webssh/issues Unraid install guide: https://github.com/bifrost0x/webssh/blob/main/docs/wiki/Install-on-Unraid.md
